description:
Use this when the user asks to remove stocks from their DalalOS watchlist. Changes only the user's own saved list.

`symbols` is a list or one string, and may be a pasted list separated by commas, semicolons, new lines, tabs or pipes, up to 200 entries. Each entry is a symbol as get_watchlist returns it, or the ISIN or BSE code of a company on the list; company names are not matched. To clear the list, call get_watchlist and pass every symbol it returns. Returns `removed` and `not_found`. Needs a signed-in DalalOS account.

symbols.description: List of symbols as get_watchlist returns them (an ISIN or BSE code also works), or one pasted string of them. Always send it as `symbols`.
symbols.title: Symbols
